name: Washington Youth ChalleNGe Academy
what_you_do: Live on campus in Bremerton for about five months in a free program for teens who have dropped out of high school or are at risk of it. You work on getting school credits back and on life skills.
who_can_apply: Washington residents who are U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents, ages 15 and a half to 18 at entry (the main page says 15 to 18). You must be behind in school, have dropped out, or be at risk of not graduating. No felony charges or pending court cases. You must choose to attend, stay drug free and be able to take part.
pay_detail: Free. The page calls it a free life intervention and credit retrieval program.
duration: 22 weeks on campus (a 147-day class cycle), then a two-year follow-up phase
deadline_text: Applications are open for the class that starts Jan 11, 2027. No closing date is posted. Spots go first come, first served.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Send the doctor and dentist forms and other documents (WYA.Applications@mil.wa.gov or fax 360-473-2623). Then do an interview and final review. Phone: 877-228-8947.
notes: This is for teens who are off track in school, not a job program. Campus: 1207 Carver Street, Bremerton, WA 98312.
